description: Official docs for Infino — the embedded retrieval engine (SQL, BM25 full-text, and vector search over one copy of your data) and Infino Cloud, its hosted service.
rules: Infino runs embedded (connect to memory://, a filesystem path, or an s3://, az://, or gs:// URI — in-process, no server) or hosted on Infino Cloud; connect / create-table / append / search / query_sql work the same in both.
Connect to Infino Cloud with an https URI: connect("https://api.platform.infino.ws/<database>") — the https scheme switches the same SDK to the hosted transport.
Install the same SDK for local and Cloud: 'pip install infino' (Python), 'npm install @infino-ai/infino' (Node.js), or 'cargo add infino' (Rust).

Infino Cloud authenticates with an API key beginning inf_, minted only in the console at platform.infino.ws; pass it to connect (api_key / apiKey / with_api_key) or set the INFINO_API_KEY environment variable.

A single Infino Cloud request body is capped at 5 MiB (HTTP 413 over it, nothing written); aim for at most 4 MiB of Arrow data per append batch and treat the last MiB as encoding headroom. Embedded use has no request cap.
One append is one atomic commit, so batch size is the main ingest-throughput knob: prefer batches near the 4 MiB target over many small appends, and split large loads into a loop.

Search with bm25_search(column, query, k), vector_search(column, query_vector, k), or hybrid_search(text_column, text_query, vector_column, query_vector, k) — hybrid fuses BM25 and vector rankings with reciprocal-rank fusion.
The search functions are also SQL table functions, so they compose into query_sql as relations you can JOIN, filter, and aggregate.
Provide your own embedding vectors for vector columns and vector queries; Infino stores and searches vectors but does not generate embeddings.
Not every local capability is hosted yet — check the local-vs-hosted parity matrix in the API reference before assuming a feature works on Infino Cloud.
Infino Cloud errors carry retry guidance: some clear on retry and some never will — consult the Errors & retries page rather than retrying everything.

For AI agents, the Infino MCP server (@infino-ai/mcp-server) exposes the same search tools locally and on Infino Cloud; LangChain, CrewAI, and Vercel AI SDK integrations are documented under Integrations.
